name: Burning Building
disable: DC 19 Survival check to beat the flames with a stage curtain or similar cloth, DC 14 Acrobatics check to splash liquids onto the fire, or 5 points of cold damage.

items.name: Conflagration
items.text:
Trigger A creature starts its turn in a burning building

---
Effect The creature must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save save or take 1d6 fire damage

items.name: Spread
items.text:
Trigger The round ends and no creature has attempted to Disable it this round

---
Effect A building within 15 feet becomes a burning building. The burning building can't use Spread next round.
